items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Well, this fellow Fate Merrill then became a very fine piano player and always had the orchestra on the boat and then on and worked with all the rest of his life.

ctx.x: How long was Melton on the band?

The violin player? The violin player, yeah. The violin player was Charlie Hershoff from Dora, Illinois. And the drummer was, the name was Little. The first name I don't know. That was the three, that was the combination of piano, violin and drums. That was the first combination. And later on, of course, went to the larger orchestras. How long was Melton on the band? And then he broke in another piano player by the name of Fate Merrill, Fate Merrill from Patooga, Kentucky, to play the clap. His fellow Charlie…
